content: गत {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [गम्-क्त] .²1 Gone, departed, gone for ever; <ls>Mu. 1. 25</ls>; किं गते सलिले सेतुबन्धेन, किं गते विवाहे नक्षत्रपरीक्षया <ls>Vb. 4</ls> ‘what is the use of locking the stable-door when the steed is stolen?’ .²2 Passed away, elapsed, past; गतायां रात्रौ. .²3 Dead, deceased, departed to the next world; गत एव न ते निवर्तते <ls>Ku. 4. 30</ls>. .²4 Gone to, arrived at, reaching to. .²5 Being in, situated in, resting on, contained in; usually in <ab>comp.</ab>; प्रासादप्रान्तगतः <ls>Pt. 1</ls> seated on <ab>&c.</ab>; सदोगतः <ls>R. 3. 66</ls> seated in the assembly; भर्तारं गता <ls>Ś. 4. 13</ls> united to a husband; so आद्य˚; सर्वगत existing everywhere. .²6 Fallen into, reduced to; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} आपद्गतः .²7 Referring or relating to, with regard to, about, concerning, connected with (usually in <ab>comp.</ab>); राजा शकुन्तलागतमेव चिन्तयति <ls>Ś. 5</ls>; भर्तृगतया चिन्तया <ls>Ś. 4</ls>; वयमपि भवत्यौ सखीगतं किमपि पृच्छामः <ls>Ś. 1</ls>; so पुत्रगतः स्नेहः <ab>&c.</ab> .²8 Frequented, resorted to; सुहृद्˚ <ls>Ku. 4. 24</ls>. .²9 Known, celebrated. .²10 Directed towards, belonging to. .²11 Known, understood. .{@-तम्@} .²1 Motion, going; गतमुपरि घनानां वारिगर्भोदराणाम् <ls>Ś. 7. 7</ls>; <ls>Śi. 1. 2</ls>, <ls n="Śi.">7. 4</ls>. .²2 Gait, manner of going; <ls>Ku. 1. 34</ls>; हंस प्रयच्छ मे कान्ता गतिरस्यास्त्वया हृता <ls>V. 4. 16</ls>. .²3 An event. .²4 The place where one has gone. .²5 Celebration, being known, diffusion; यावन्नाम्नो गतम् <ls>Ch. Up. 7. 1. 5</ls>. .²6 Manner. (As first member of <ab>comp.</ab> translated by ‘free from’, ‘bereft of’, ‘deprived of’, ‘without’.)
